steps.speaker: Terminal
steps.content: Bzzz.
The social media app on the terminal sends a familiar notification sound.

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: Darling, are you there?

<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>: Who are you?

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: That hurts, babe...
<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: We were virtually inseparable online just a month ago. Have you forgotten me already?
A month ago... You try to recall. That was during the Gray Mirror vote incident.
Given the person's cheeky tone, you quickly come to the correct conclusion...

<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>: Are you Shawn?
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>: What do you want from me?

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: Nothing in particular.
<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: Just wanted to touch base.
The other person types quickly, sending a sentence every two seconds, but there's a slight pause here.
As if she's guessed the expression on your face on the other end, another message pops up in the chat a while later.

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: Hold on... Actually, I do have a serious matter to discuss with you.

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: Which is... I love you.

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: In fact, I did already confess to you when we first met, but unfortunately, our real date fell through, and now we've lost touch with each other.

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic</color>: It took me a lot of effort to find your contact. Let's pick up where we left off, you and I...
She may type fast, but you press the delete and block buttons faster.
This isn't the first time you've received such harassing messages, and this is the simplest and best way to deal with them. Responding only makes things worse.

As for this Sinner, considering that she poses no immediate threat in addition to the recent heavy workload at the MBCC, you decide it's not unwise to put her case on hold and arrest her later once you have the time.
Thinking this, you turn off the device screen and continue with your work.
You're just done with a few documents when the notification buzzes again.

steps.speaker: Terminal
steps.content: Bzzz.

steps.speaker: Terminal
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau Special Agent 3</color> sent a friend request.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Since when did the Public Security Bureau start contacting me through social media... Why don't they use their own messenger app?
You wonder as your finger instinctively taps accept.
The next second, serial messages swamp the entire screen.

<color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau Special Agent 3</color>: To tell you the truth, from the first moment I saw you, my heart stopped.
<color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau Special Agent 3</color>: Perhaps it was written in the stars. But then, I was afraid that you'd find it too rushed and reject me... As it turns out, I was probably right.
<color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau Special Agent 3</color>: It's been a month now. Maybe time has emboldened me, or the dread of losing you has surpassed the fear of being rejected.
<color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau Special Agent 3</color>: I know, I've always been a coward. But this time, I've decided to be brave.
<color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau Special Agent 3</color>: Call me a moth to a flame. After all, my life and my heart are already battered and bruised. What more do I have to lose?
It takes you less than 1.5 seconds to delete and block this time.
A change of plan is due. You underestimated the harm this Sinner could cause. It seems you have to move the arrest up your schedule.
At lunch, you scroll on your terminal while stuffing food from the plate into your mouth.
Suddenly, a notification pops up at the top of the screen.

steps.speaker: Terminal
steps.content: Bzzz.

<color=#fb9259>Eastside Councilor 24</color> sent a friend request.

Note: Please add me on here. This is my personal account.
You've never gotten along with the council, and that name is too ridiculous even for a personal account. You don't have to guess to know who that might be.
You're getting better at this reject and block thing. It now takes less than one second.
At 3:15 a.m., having finished the day's work and your nighttime routine, you collapse onto the bed.

steps.speaker: Terminal
steps.content: Bzzz.
The ominous notification sound tenses you up.
Out of job duty, you can't just ignore it. But as soon as you turn on the terminal, you immediately regret it.

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic 2929</color> sent a friend request.
Note: I understand now. You refuse me. But what

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic 8811</color> sent a friend request.
Note: of it? If I can't have your love, I want your hatred at least. Being hated

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic 0391</color> sent a friend request.
Note: is better than being forgotten. I just want to secure a place

<color=#fb9259>Hopeless Romantic 7268</color> sent a friend request.
Note: in your heart. As long as you remember me, I still have a chance
You don't wait for the sweet talker to clog up your chat. Instead, you tap uninstall decisively.
This Sinner poses a significant threat and must not be allowed to roam free. You decide to initiate an arrest as soon as you finish breakfast the next day.

steps.speaker: Unknown Number
steps.content: Ting-a-ling...

options: Hang up and turn off the Terminal

choices.text: Hang up and turn off the Terminal

steps.content: So this can't wait until tomorrow.
5:20 a.m., inside an Eastside apartment.
A dozen of fully armed operatives spread out neatly, moving toward the fourth floor without a sound.
Door breaching tool in hand, the operatives are about to barge in...
You knock on the slightly worn and poorly soundproofed door.
Coming!
...Babe, I didn't realize we'd been chatting for so long. My food delivery's here. Just one sec, be right back...
The moment the door opens, a woman with fair skin and a slender figure comes into view.
The two of you lock eyes for a second.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Aren't we supposed to meet in person, "Hopeless Romantic"?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Here I am.
As you speak, an incredible range of expressions flashes by the woman's face in just a few seconds.
Finally, she gives a hearty smile and opens her arms towards you.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Watch out! She's going to attack Chief!
The operatives around you raise their guns. Your previous close calls have made them a bit overreactive.
Clearly, the woman in front of you doesn't seem poised for "attack". It seems the only way to spare her some suffering is to subdue her yourself.

Before the operatives can fire, you grab the woman's arm. She's lighter than you expected and seems to be weaker in strength than you. So you muster your power and bend down, the whole sequence clean and swift.
Thump—
Two seconds later, staring down at the unconscious Sinner, the operatives report the situation to the intel center.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Operation successful. The target is unconscious.
At this moment, you finally feel utterly relieved.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Take her away. Let's head back.
Since entering the interrogation room, the woman hasn't taken her eyes off you for a second. Those eyes are filled with an unsettling affection that makes your skin crawl.

options: Tell me, why did you approach me?

choices.text: Tell me, why did you approach me?

steps.content: Even when being grilled, Shawn shows no guilt or hesitation.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Because I can't shake my feelings for you. Didn't I tell you that from the beginning?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I just didn't expect your love to be even more fervent than mine, to the extent that you couldn't even wait for us to get to know each other more before using such an extreme method to approach me...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Such desperate measures and possessiveness that would surely be shunned by ordinary people... How could I not fall for you, darling?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Now, I'm only afraid I can't keep up with your pace... Let me know before your next flirtatious gesture so I can be better prepared, will you?
Sweet talk is her comfort zone. Her words may sound candid, but none of them is true.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Do you consider an arrest by the Bureau a form of flirtation?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Of course. Everyone has their own love language. Given how stressed the average person is in DisCity, I wouldn't even consider this a quirk.
As she speaks, Shawn ruffles her already disheveled hair.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: That was a nice throw, perfect in strength and form. Not only was I not hurt, but I was also cured of my stubborn insomnia.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I could feel all your love and care in that one single throw. Thanks, babe!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It was meant as a punishment.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Encourage her

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A retaliation for your repeated harassment.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Haha...
Shawn bows slightly, as if she has discovered a secret about you.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: So, this is the excuse you use in front of your subordinates, huh?... You're quite self-conscious about your image, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Relax, you can punish me as much as you want from now on. I won't let it slip. Let this be our little secret...
Shawn's voice is deep and magnetic, but her words give you chills.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You've probably used this kind of sweet talk on many others too, right?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You've been casting nets across various social platforms and attracted countless victims. Be honest, tell me all about them and your intentions.

She's never tried to conceal her identity as a Sinner since her capture, as if nothing else matters to her aside from her online relationships. Your investigative instincts tell you there's more to it.
Although faced with your pressing questions, Shawn doesn't seem inclined to come clean. She stretches her back lazily and begins in a wistful and languid tone.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: That will defy the purpose, darling. Online love affairs are fleeting encounters. What's the point of getting to the bottom of it? You know, mystery is the source of romantic tension.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I understand it's just your possessiveness acting up. You want to have all of Hopeless Romantic's secrets to yourself... But sorry, it's not gonna happen.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: You're right, you're not my only romantic partner online. I belong to every lonely soul in DisCity. A bird destined to soar in the sky can't linger on the same branch forever...
She wraps her arms around herself dramatically, basking in her own self-induced emotions.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you admitting to juggling multiple online relationships? How many romantic partners do you have exactly?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Hmm... I haven't actually counted, but probably... around a hundred? What's the matter, Chief? Are you jealous?
The mind-blowing number rolls off her tongue as casually as if she were talking about what she had for dinner yesterday. If you let her babble on, this interrogation will never end.
When you think of how over a hundred ordinary citizens also face the same ordeal as you do, constantly harassed by this professional scammer, a sense of indignation burns within you.

options: Time to take a more drastic approach

choices.text: Time to take a more drastic approach

steps.content: You approach her with a stiff smile.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Long-term use of electronic devices can lead to insomnia, which can cause severe mental distress, and a Sinner's mental state is closely related to the stability of Mania! For your health and safety, this bad habit must be regulated.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now that you're here at the MBCC, your well-being is my responsibility as Chief... Hand over all of your communication terminals. You have to stay off the internet for a while.
Hearing your words, Shawn freezes for a moment.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Ah? Oh... That won't be necessary. That over-the-shoulder throw has completely cured me. I no longer have trouble sleeping now.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's only the second day you've been here. How can you know for sure?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your condition must be monitored closely. We take the physical health of Sinners very seriously here at the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Do... Do you confiscate personal terminals from all Sinners here?
You give her a lukewarm smile. Feeling the change in the atmosphere in the interrogation room, Shawn finally realizes you're not joking.
A drop of cold sweat trickles down her forehead.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Can we not do this, babe? Just tell me what you want. I'll reserve two hours just for you every day... No, three... four... How about eight hours? I'll report to you like it's my job. Can't you just give me a bit of space? Let me breathe some free air online?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: You don't really expect me to stick with you around the clock, do you? I love you, but I have my own life too. Besides, would you really be so cruel as to break a hundred cute girls' hearts all at once?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Didn't you say I was too possessive? As one of DisCity's stressed citizens, it's normal to have a quirk or two.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Confiscating your communication terminal is my quirk.
Shawn looks at you in shock. She probably never expected you to use her own words against her.
Realizing she's completely outmaneuvered, Shawn finally raises her hands in surrender.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I surrender, darling. You've bested me...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: But about quitting the internet... Maybe we should think twice?
Shawn peeks at your face before going on to explain.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: We really shouldn't rush it... You know how much of an issue mental health is in DisCity. You don't think an outgoing, mentally healthy person would be fooled by a catfish like me, do you?

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: A few of those kids... Well, they were already on the brink of a mental breakdown before we met.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Not to toot my own horn, but I'm part of the reason why they haven't attempted to harm themselves... They may even consider me a pillar of support or a reason to keep living on.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: What will they do if I suddenly disappear?
Your "drastic approach" seems to have worked. Shawn drops her previously flippant tone, and even her expression becomes more solemn.
She sighs softly, a look of resignation on her face. Under your gaze, she taps on the social media app and pulls up a friend list named "Darlings".

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: This is Atia, the daughter of Wellmart's owner. She's a young, passionate, and generous lover.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: She thinks I'm a poor art student from Eastside School of Art. She's still sponsoring me and paying my rent... Apparently, it's the only thing that gives her a sense of purpose. She feels the most energetic when she sends me money.
Though she seems generally listless, Shawn seems quite confident when talking about her "prey".

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Northshore Breeze, this one's from Syn... Um, now it's called the West District. Used to be in a gang, but I think she's already quit.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: And this one, "Ragdoll Kitty". She's just a shy, adorable girl with an angelic voice...
Shawn's finger flies over the screen, then she stops at another name.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: And then there's Ceci...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: This kid, well. Her dad's a gambler and her mom's been bedridden for years. She worked really hard and got into Banyan Medical College and has been juggling school and work.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: The past two years have been very hard for her. I've been through everything with her...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: We've talked about our dreams, poetry and life beyond the here and now. I used to tell her bedtime stories with my most charming voice too. Those memories still warm my heart...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Just get to the point.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Hmm, the point...
Her finger lingers over the name "Slumber under Cherry".

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: This girl... The person she loved died a few years ago. Her mental condition hasn't been good and she's been suicidal several times.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I've almost used up all the sweet nothings I could think of just to persuade her against suicide...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: She wanted me to stay with her forever. "Forever" is a lie in itself, but I still promised her.

As Shawn talks, you keep observing her. In her indifferent demeanor, you finally catch a glimpse of sincerity. Watching her finger linger over those names, you might have found a breakthrough in this conversation.
She may not be lying. These people do need her and depend on her, and for their sake, Shawn can't easily cut herself off from them. But she also hasn't told the whole truth.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They may need you, but what can you get from them?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yes, you. Why do you do these things?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've had my revenge on you for your harassment with that throw. Making you quit the internet is not really my quirk. Forcing you to cut ties with people is just a means of interrogation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've never heard you talk about your true feelings like this before. Let's have a heart-to-heart, shall we?
She's dazed for a moment, then quickly bows her head to avoid your probing gaze.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: That's why I rarely do real dates. I can't stand a crystal-clear gaze like yours.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Why do I go around flirting with people online... If I say I have no idea, would you believe me?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But we can find the answer together.
You point at the communication terminal in her hand on which there's an endless list of names.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Maybe you'll know the reason why you're addicted to talking with them under a mask when you take it off.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: In the end, you still want me to quit the internet...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So, will you do it or not?
You pretend to leave the choice to Shawn, watching her reaction.
Uncharacteristically, she doesn't try to sweet-talk herself out of this, looking down at each of the IDs she's conversed with seriously.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Promise me to just tell the truth to those who are more stable, so they can move on. But for the rest...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I understand. We'll take a gentler approach with the special cases. We'll monitor them and ease them into the truth.

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: So this day has finally come. In the end, love built on lies can't last. I knew it...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: I knew it. You're just jealous!

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: You want me to watch my exes leave me, huh? I gotta say, you're kinda sadistic...

steps.speaker: Shawn
steps.content: Well, you'll have me all to yourself then. I'm in your thrall, babe.
As if the sincere confession never happened, the heartbreaker returns to her usual nonchalant self, throwing you a coquettish wink.
